description: Refresh one live AutoSEO article from its own Search Console queries. Cituna writes a new SEO title and meta description, adds up to two FAQ answers, and updates the live page on the site it was published to: the URL, headline, body and publication date stay, and the title and description it overwrites come back as `before`. Call it only for an article list_articles shows with `enrich.eligible: true`. One that is not due, or was edited on the site since Cituna sent it, is refused before anything is spent, with `refreshed: false` and a `reason`. A refresh uses one generation from the monthly allowance and one Search Console read. WRITE ACTION: changes a live page on the site; requires a Pro plan or higher.
name: enrich_article
